# tenarium_tenant_sso (Resource)

The single sign-on (OIDC or SAML) connection of a tenant. A tenant has at most one. Every email domain must be a verified `tenarium_tenant_domain` of the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenarium_tenant_sso" "oidc" {
  tenant_id      = tenarium_tenant.acme.id
  issuer         = "https://login.acme.example/realms/acme"
  client_id      = "tenarium"
  client_secret  = var.oidc_client_secret
  domains        = [tenarium_tenant_domain.app.hostname]
  enforce        = true
  auto_provision = true
  default_role   = "member"
}

# SAML: give the identity provider's metadata as XML or a URL.
resource "tenarium_tenant_sso" "saml" {
  tenant_id            = tenarium_tenant.globex.id
  protocol             = "saml"
  saml_metadata_url    = "https://idp.globex.example/metadata.xml"
  saml_email_attribute = "email"
  domains              = ["globex.example"]
}

variable "oidc_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domains` (Set of String) Email domains whose users sign in through this connection. Each must be a verified domain of the tenant.
- `tenant_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the tenant. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Create users and memberships on first sign-in. Defaults to `false`.
- `client_id` (String) OIDC client ID (required for OIDC).
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OIDC client secret (required for OIDC). The API never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `default_role` (String) Role given to auto-provisioned members. Defaults to `member`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection can be used. Defaults to `true`.
- `enforce` (Boolean) Refuse password logins for users of the domains. Defaults to `false`.
- `issuer` (String) OIDC issuer URL (required for OIDC). For SAML it is the identity provider's entity ID, read from the metadata.
- `protocol` (String) `oidc` (default) or `saml`.
- `saml_email_attribute` (String) SAML attribute carrying the email address.
- `saml_metadata` (String) SAML identity provider metadata XML. The API never returns it. One of `saml_metadata` and `saml_metadata_url` is required for SAML.
- `saml_metadata_url` (String) URL to fetch the SAML metadata from.
- `saml_name_attribute` (String) SAML attribute carrying the display name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `tenant_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tenarium_tenant_sso.oidc <tenant_id>
```
